result:
Regression fixed. In `anthrouter/http_util.py`, `_RATELIMIT_HEADERS` read `anthropic-ratelimit-request-remaining` (singular). The real header is `anthropic-ratelimit-requests-remaining`, so the requests-remaining value was never recorded. I corrected the header name.

Re-running the full suite gives 1125 passed, 3 failed. The three that still fail don't touch rate-limit recording. I think they predate this regression, but I didn't run them against the original code to confirm:
- `tests/test_config.py::test_editable_fields_live_editable_fields`
- `tests/test_handlers.py::test_cached_tier_is_not_replayed_into_a_different_requested_tier`
- `tests/test_handlers.py::test_locked_baseline_scopes_the_tier_slot_by_the_lock`

I left them alone, as you asked.
